Subject-Numeric Central Files. In February 1963, the Department adopted a subject-numeric central file system. The following files for the period February through December 1963 were most useful in compiling this volume:
DEF 1-4 INDIA: Indian air defense
DEF 7 INDIA-US: U.S. military visits and missions to India
DEF 12 INDIA: Military equipment and supplies for India
DEF 19 US-INDIA and DEF 19-3 US-INDIA: Military assistance to India

POL 7 INDIA: Visits by and meetings with Indian officials
POL 7 US/BALL: George Ball’s visit to South Asia
POL 15 AFG: Afghan government

POL 33-1 INDIA PAK/INDUS: Relations between India and Pakistan concerning Indus waters issues

Lot Files. Documents from the central files have been supplemented by lot files of the Department, which are decentralized files created by operating areas. A list of the principal lot files cited in this volume follows:
Conference Files: Lot 65 D 366
Collection of documentation on official visits by heads of government and foreign ministers to the United States and on major international conferences attended by the Secretary of State, as maintained by the Executive Secretariat
Confererence Files: Lot 66 D 110
Collection of documentation on international conferences abroad attended by the President, the Secretary of State, and other U.S. officials, May 1961-December 1964, as maintained by the Executuve Secretariat

Secretary’s Memoranda of Conversation: Lot 65 D 330
Memoranda of the Secretary’s and Under Secretary’s conversations for the years 1961-1964, as maintained by the Executive Secretariat
